sections.description: Advanced modular WordPress security suite featuring User Enumeration Protection, Brute-Force Rate Limiting, Custom Login URL, Native TOTP 2FA, XML-RPC Shield, WAF Firewall, Sensitive File Protection, and Activity Logs.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Cookie Security Hardening: Enforces HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax/Strict, and Secure flags across all outgoing cookies, completely resolving Netsparker/Invicti and OWASP ZAP CWE-1004 / CWE-1275 vulnerabilities (including third-party cookies like icwp-wpsf-notbot).
  • Theme Directory Direct Execution Protection: Prevents HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors when vulnerability scanners or bots probe theme directories (such as /wp-content/themes/abdos/) or raw PHP template files.
  • GitHub ZIP Architecture Fix: Streamlined repository root so GitHub repository archives (WP-Secure-Guard-main.zip) install and activate cleanly without any header validation errors.

1.0.0

  • Initial stable release with 20 modular security protections.
  • Custom Login URL & Direct Endpoint Blocking.
  • Sensitive File Protection & Directory Listing Shield.
  • Remote Auto-Updater integrated.
